## 项目概述

本报告用于复现一篇土壤生物与生物地球化学相关论文中的部分图表。

### 复现内容

- **图 1**：土壤有机碳组分箱线图
- **图 2**：土壤有机碳分子的旋转主成分分析（PCA）双图
- **扩展数据图 ED2**：土壤与植物生物地球化学特征箱线图
- **扩展数据图 ED4**：不同植被类型与火干扰下的碳组分差异箱线图
- **扩展数据图 ED5**：土壤有机碳分子组分相关性热图

## 项目环境

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```

## 数据加载与预处理

```{r data_load}
# 加载所需包
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)

# 加载 NMR 数据
data <- read.csv("../data/raw/Hall_Ye_etal_NEON_NMR_biogeo.csv", header = TRUE)

# 构建碳分子丰度数据框
mat1 <- data.frame(data[, c("Lignin_fraction", "Carbohydrate_fraction",
                             "Lipid_fraction", "Protein_fraction",
                             "Char_fraction", "Carbonyl_fraction")])
row.names(mat1) <- data$siteID

# 构建碳官能团数据框
mat1_1 <- data.frame(data[, c("Alkyl_fraction", "N_Alkyl_Methoxyl_fraction",
                               "O_Alkyl_fraction", "Di_O_Alkyl_fraction",
                               "Aromatic_fraction", "Phenolic_fraction",
                               "Amide_Carboxyl_fraction")])
row.names(mat1_1) <- data$siteID

# 旋转 PCA 分析
mat2.3 <- principal(mat1, nfactors = 3, rotate = 'varimax', covar = FALSE)

# 提取主成分得分
data1 <- cbind(data, mat2.3$scores)
```

## 图 1：土壤有机碳组分箱线图

```{r fig1, fig.cap="土壤有机碳组分箱线图", fig.width=6.25, fig.height=3.5}
# 构建分子类别数据
test <- c(data$Carbohydrate_fraction, data$Protein_fraction, data$Lignin_fraction,
          data$Lipid_fraction, data$Char_fraction, data$Carbonyl_fraction)

trts <- c(rep("    Carbohydrate", 42), rep("Protein", 42), rep("Lignin", 42),
          rep("Lipid", 42), rep("Char", 42), rep("Carbonyl", 42))
trts <- as.factor(trts)
SOM <- data.frame(test, trts)

# 统计检验
lm1 <- lm(test ~ trts, SOM)
anova(lm1)

# 排列因子水平
SOM$trts <- factor(SOM$trts, levels = c("    Carbohydrate", "Lignin", "Lipid",
                                         "Protein", "Char", "Carbonyl"))

# 绘制分子类别箱线图
plot_SOM <- ggplot(SOM, aes(trts, test)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.1), color = "grey50") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete("C molecule") +
  scale_y_continuous("Fractional abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 构建官能团数据
test1 <- c(data$Alkyl_fraction, data$N_Alkyl_Methoxyl_fraction,
           data$O_Alkyl_fraction, data$Di_O_Alkyl_fraction,
           data$Aromatic_fraction, data$Phenolic_fraction, data$Amide_Carboxyl_fraction)

trts1 <- c(rep("Alkyl", 42), rep("N-Alkyl/Methoxyl", 42), rep("O-Alkyl", 42),
           rep("Di-O-Alkyl", 42), rep("Aromatic", 42), rep("Phenolic", 42),
           rep("Amide/Carboxyl", 42))

SOM1 <- data.frame(test1, trts1)
SOM1$trts1 <- factor(SOM1$trts1, levels = c("O-Alkyl", "Alkyl", "Aromatic",
                                              "Amide/Carboxyl", "N-Alkyl/Methoxyl",
                                              "Phenolic", "Di-O-Alkyl"))

# 绘制官能团箱线图
plot_SOM_comp <- ggplot(SOM1, aes(trts1, test1)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.1), color = "grey50") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete("C functional group") +
  scale_y_continuous("Fractional abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 组合图1
p1 <- plot_grid(plot_SOM_comp, plot_SOM, nrow = 1, labels = c("a", "b"))
print(p1)
```

## 图 2：PCA 排序图

```{r fig2, fig.cap="土壤有机碳分子 PCA 排序图", fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
# 重命名列
colnames(mat1) <- c("Lignin", "Carbohyd", "Lipid", "Protein", "Char", "Carbonyl")

# 旋转 PCA
mat2.3 <- principal(mat1, nfactors = 3, rotate = 'varimax', covar = FALSE)

# 绘制三组 biplot
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(3, 3, 1.5, 1.5), tck = -0.02, mgp = c(1.5, 0.25, 0), cex = 1.2)

biplot(mat2.3, choose = c(1, 2),
       xlim.s = c(-3, 3), ylim.s = c(-3, 3),
       xlim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15), ylim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15),
       pch = 20, col = c(rgb(0, 0, 0, max = 255, alpha = 75), "darkgreen"))
mtext("a", font = 2, at = c(-1.5), cex = 1.3, line = 0.5)

biplot(mat2.3, choose = c(2, 3),
       xlim.s = c(-3, 3), ylim.s = c(-3, 3),
       xlim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15), ylim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15),
       pch = 20, col = c(rgb(0, 0, 0, max = 255, alpha = 75), "darkgreen"))
mtext("b", font = 2, at = c(-1.5), cex = 1.3, line = 0.5)

biplot(mat2.3, choose = c(1, 3),
       xlim.s = c(-3, 3), ylim.s = c(-3, 3),
       xlim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15), ylim.f = c(-1.15, 1.15),
       pch = 20, col = c(rgb(0, 0, 0, max = 255, alpha = 75), "darkgreen"))
mtext("c", font = 2, at = c(-1.5), cex = 1.3, line = 0.5)
```

## 扩展数据图 ED2：环境因子分布箱线图

```{r fig_ed2, fig.cap="环境因子分布箱线图", fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# 计算结晶铁
data1$Fe_crystalline <- data1$DithioniteFe_g_kg - data1$OxalateFe_g_kg
data1$Fe_crystalline_log10 <- log10(data1$Fe_crystalline)

# 选择环境因子子集
datared <- data1[, c("siteID", "Oxalate_Fe_mg_g_ICP", "Oxalate_Al_mg_g_ICP",
                      "Fe_crystalline", "phH2o", "Ca_plus_Mg_umol_g",
                      "live_root_lessthan_4mm_approx_mg_cm3",
                      "wgt_live_root_lessthan_4mm_CN_ratio_0_30cm",
                      "MAP_minus_PET_mm", "MAT_C",
                      "fungi_meanCopyNumber_ITS",
                      "bacteria_and_archaea_meanCopyNumber_16S",
                      "fung_bact_ratio", "clayTotal_percent",
                      "estimatedOC_g_kg", "OC_N_ratio", "nitrogenTot_g_kg",
                      "foliage_ligninPercent", "foliage_CtoN",
                      "litter_ligninPercent", "litter_CtoN")]

# 重命名列
names(datared) <- c("Site", "Alo (mg g-1)", "Feo (mg g-1)", "Fed-o (mg g-1)",
                     "pH", "Ca (mg g-1)", "Fine roots (mg cm-3)", "Fine root C:N",
                     "MAP-PET (mm)", "MAT (C)", "ITS", "16S", "ITS:16S",
                     "Clay (%)", "SOC (mg g-1)", "SOC:N", "Soil N (mg g-1)",
                     "Foliar lignin (%)", "Foliar C:N", "Litter lignin (%)", "Litter C:N")

# 转换为长格式
datared_melt <- datared %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Site, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

# 设置排序
datared_melt$ordering <- as.character(datared_melt$variable)
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "MAT (C)"] <- 1
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "MAP-PET (mm)"] <- 2
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "pH"] <- 3
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "SOC (mg g-1)"] <- 4
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Soil N (mg g-1)"] <- 5
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "SOC:N"] <- 6
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Fine roots (mg cm-3)"] <- 7
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Fine root C:N"] <- 8
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Foliar C:N"] <- 9
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Litter C:N"] <- 10
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Foliar lignin (%)"] <- 11
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Litter lignin (%)"] <- 12
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Ca (mg g-1)"] <- 13
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Alo (mg g-1)"] <- 14
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Feo (mg g-1)"] <- 15
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Fed-o (mg g-1)"] <- 16
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "Clay (%)"] <- 17
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "16S"] <- 18
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "ITS"] <- 19
datared_melt$ordering[datared_melt$ordering == "ITS:16S"] <- 20

datared_melt$ordering <- as.numeric(datared_melt$ordering)
datared_melt <- datared_melt[order(datared_melt$ordering), ]

# 设置因子水平
datared_melt$variable <- factor(datared_melt$variable,
                                 levels = c("MAT (C)", "MAP-PET (mm)", "pH",
                                            "SOC (mg g-1)", "Soil N (mg g-1)", "SOC:N",
                                            "Fine roots (mg cm-3)", "Fine root C:N",
                                            "Foliar C:N", "Litter C:N",
                                            "Foliar lignin (%)", "Litter lignin (%)",
                                            "Ca (mg g-1)", "Alo (mg g-1)", "Feo (mg g-1)",
                                            "Fed-o (mg g-1)", "Clay (%)", "16S", "ITS", "ITS:16S"))

# 定义面板标签
panel_names <- c(
  "MAT (C)" = "MAT*~(degree*C)",
  "MAP-PET (mm)" = "MAP-PET*~(mm)",
  "pH" = "pH",
  "SOC (mg g-1)" = "SOC*~(mg*~g^-1)",
  "Soil N (mg g-1)" = "SON*~(mg*~g^-1)",
  "SOC:N" = "SOC:N",
  "Fine roots (mg cm-3)" = "Fine*~roots*~(mg*~cm^-3)",
  "Fine root C:N" = "Fine*~root*~C:N",
  "Foliar C:N" = "Foliar*~C:N",
  "Litter C:N" = "Litter*~C:N",
  "Foliar lignin (%)" = "Foliar*~lignin*~('%')",
  "Litter lignin (%)" = "Litter*~lignin*~('%')",
  "Ca (mg g-1)" = "Ca*~+Mg*~(mu*mol*~g^-1)",
  "Alo (mg g-1)" = "Al[o]*~(mg*~g^-1)",
  "Feo (mg g-1)" = "Fe[o]*~(mg*~g^-1)",
  "Fed-o (mg g-1)" = "Fe[d-o]*~(mg*~g^-1)",
  "Clay (%)" = "Clay*~('%')",
  "16S" = "16*S",
  "ITS" = "ITS",
  "ITS:16S" = "ITS*':'*16*S"
)

# 绘制 ED2
print(ggplot(datared_melt, aes(1, value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(0.1), color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(variable = as_labeller(panel_names, label_parsed))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete("") +
  scale_y_continuous(""))
```

## 扩展数据图 ED4：碳组分与环境因子关系图

```{r fig_ed4, fig.cap="不同植被类型与火干扰下的碳组分差异", fig.width=4, fig.height=8}
# 准备分组数据
SOM2 <- data.frame(SOM, rep(data$forest_vs_non), rep(data$Prescribed_fire))

names(SOM2)[names(SOM2) == "rep.data.forest_vs_non."] <- "Vegetation"
SOM2$Vegetation[SOM2$Vegetation == 0] <- "Other"
SOM2$Vegetation[SOM2$Vegetation == 1] <- "Forest"
SOM2$Vegetation <- factor(SOM2$Vegetation, levels = c("Forest", "Other"))

names(SOM2)[names(SOM2) == "rep.data.Prescribed_fire."] <- "Fire"
SOM2$Fire[SOM2$Fire == 0] <- "No"
SOM2$Fire[SOM2$Fire == 1] <- "Yes"
SOM2$Fire <- factor(SOM2$Fire, levels = c("No", "Yes"))

# 绘制植被类型面板
S4_a <- ggplot(SOM2, aes(trts, test, fill = Vegetation)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete("C functional group") +
  scale_y_continuous("Fractional abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 绘制火干扰面板
S4_b <- ggplot(SOM2, aes(trts, test, fill = Fire)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(), alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_discrete("C functional group") +
  scale_y_continuous("Fractional abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 组合 ED4
pED4 <- plot_grid(S4_a, S4_b, nrow = 2, labels = c("a", "b"))
print(pED4)
```

## 扩展数据图 ED5：有机碳分子组分相关性热图

```{r fig_ed5, fig.cap="土壤有机碳分子组分相关性热图", fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
# 碳组分数据
comps <- data1[, c("Carbohydrate_fraction", "Protein_fraction", "Lignin_fraction",
                    "Lipid_fraction", "Char_fraction", "Carbonyl_fraction")]
names(comps) <- c("Carbohydrate", "Protein", "Lignin", "Lipid", "Char", "Carbonyl")

# 计算相关矩阵
NMR_cor_vars <- as.matrix(cor(comps, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

# 获取上三角
get_upper_tri <- function(cormat) {
  cormat[lower.tri(cormat)] <- NA
  return(cormat)
}

# 重排序
reorder_cormat <- function(cormat) {
  dd <- as.dist((1 - cormat) / 2)
  hc <- hclust(dd)
  cormat <- cormat[hc$order, hc$order]
}

cormat <- reorder_cormat(NMR_cor_vars)
cormat_upper <- get_upper_tri(cormat)

# 将矩阵转换为长格式
NMR_cormat_upper <- as.data.frame(cormat_upper) %>%
  mutate(X1 = row.names(cormat_upper)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -X1, names_to = "X2", values_to = "r") %>%
  filter(!is.na(r))

# 设置因子水平
NMR_cormat_upper$X2 <- factor(NMR_cormat_upper$X2,
                               levels = c("Carbonyl", "Lignin", "Char", "Lipid", "Protein", "Carbohydrate"))
NMR_cormat_upper$X1 <- factor(NMR_cormat_upper$X1,
                               levels = c("Carbonyl", "Lignin", "Char", "Lipid", "Protein", "Carbohydrate"))

# 计算相关系数矩阵
r <- cor(comps, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# 四舍五入相关系数
NMR_cormat_upper$r <- round(NMR_cormat_upper$r, 2)
NMR_cormat_upper$Corr <- NMR_cormat_upper$r
NMR_cormat_upper$Corr[NMR_cormat_upper$Corr < 0] <- -1
NMR_cormat_upper$Corr[NMR_cormat_upper$Corr > 0] <- 1
NMR_cormat_upper$Corr[NMR_cormat_upper$Corr == 1] <- "black"
NMR_cormat_upper$Corr[NMR_cormat_upper$Corr == -1] <- "white"

# 绘制热图
plot_corr_map <- ggplot(data = NMR_cormat_upper) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = X2, y = X1, fill = r)) +
  scale_fill_viridis() +
  scale_y_discrete("") +
  scale_x_discrete("") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)) +
  geom_text(data = NMR_cormat_upper,
            mapping = aes(x = X2, y = X1, label = r),
            color = NMR_cormat_upper$Corr)

print(plot_corr_map)
```
